description:
Space Mission Design Game
The Space Mission Design Game is an exciting and educational game where players become space scientists and astronauts. In this game, we design our own rockets, choose planets to explore, plan space journeys, and complete exciting missions. We learn about the solar system, gravity, astronauts, and spacecraft while having fun. The main goal is to explore space, discover new things, and complete missions successfully. It helps us improve our creativity, problem-solving
